title: An interactive script: an intent by its phrase, a slot, a question for a missing slot, the end phrase

steps.js: window.__said = []; const r0 = Voice.respond; Voice.respond = async (m, then, o) => { __said.push(String(m)); then?.(); }; await Script.start({ name: 'Desk helper', mode: 'interactive', listen: false, setup: [ { say: 'Hi! What can I do?' } ], intents: [ { id: 'sales', title: 'Show sales', on: ['show sales for {month}', 'sales'], ask: { month: 'Which month?' }, say: 'Here are the sales for {month}.' } ], fallback: [ { say: 'Sorry, I can show sales.' } ], end: { on: ['that is all', 'goodbye'], steps: [ { say: 'Talk soon!' } ] } }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return __said.join(' | ')
